BLD.Settings.PromptOnManual.Name: Prompt on manual bleed
BLD.Settings.PromptOnManual.Hint: Ask for an amount and type when the condition is applied by hand. @Bleed and the API are unaffected.
BLD.Prompt.MarkerNote: Marker Only leaves the condition inert — no automatic damage.
BLD.Prompt.Title: Apply Bleed — {name}
BLD.Prompt.DeepNote: 0 = ordinary bleed. Higher closes only through that much dedicated healing.
BLD.Enricher.TooltipDeep: Apply deep bleed ({kind}): {formula} — {deep} HP of dedicated healing to close
BLD.Enricher.NoTarget: Bleed: no target. Select or target a token first.
BLD.Display.Heading: Bleed
BLD.Display.HighestNote: Highest of each type applies each round.
BLD.Display.DeepNote: Deep: closes only through dedicated healing.
BLD.Display.SourceNote: Buff bleed ends with the buff.
BLD.Display.BlockedNote: Blocked: no healing until the cause is gone.
BLD.Deep.CannotClear: {name}'s deep bleed still needs {remaining} HP of dedicated healing.
BLD.Settings.Homebrew.Name: Astora Homebrew rules
BLD.Settings.Homebrew.Hint: Enables non-RAW rules (currently Deep Bleed). Needs pf1-critical-effects' matching setting too. Off stops new ones only.
BLD.Burning.Ignite: {name} catches fire and takes {total} fire damage.
BLD.Burning.IgniteResisted: {name} catches fire, but shrugs off the flames entirely.
BLD.Burning.Extinguish: {name} makes the save and puts out the flames.
BLD.Burning.Persists: {name} makes the save, but the flames are being sustained and keep burning.
BLD.Burning.Burn: {name} fails to douse the flames and takes {total} fire damage.
BLD.Burning.AutoDamage: {name} takes {total} fire damage from the flames.
BLD.Burning.AutoNoSave: {name} takes {total} fire damage from the flames (no save attempted).
BLD.Burning.Resisted: {name} keeps burning, but shrugs off the flames entirely.
BLD.Burning.Immune: {name} is immune to fire and cannot be set alight.
BLD.Burning.ImmuneMarker: {name} is immune to fire — the flames do nothing.
BLD.Burning.SaveFlavor: {name} is on fire — Reflex DC {dc} to put it out.
BLD.Burning.Card.SaveButton: Reflex Save (DC {dc}) to put out the flames
BLD.Burning.Enricher.Tooltip: Set on fire (1d6 fire/round, Reflex DC {dc} to put out)
BLD.Burning.Enricher.TooltipNoSave: Set on fire (1d6 fire/round, no save to put out)
BLD.Burning.Enricher.NoTarget: Burning: no target. Select or target a token first.
BLD.Settings.SavePrompt.Name: Reflex save vs. burning
BLD.Settings.SavePrompt.Hint: Burning creatures may roll a Reflex save each turn to put the flames out. Off: no save is offered anywhere.
BLD.Settings.Resistance.Name: Burning respects fire resistance
BLD.Settings.Resistance.Hint: Run burning damage through fire resistance and vulnerability. Off applies it flat. Immunity always applies.
BLD.Buff.BleedHint: Dealt each round while active. Blank = inert marker.
BLD.Buff.ModePersistHint: Inflicted once on activation; stays after the buff ends.
BLD.Buff.BurningHint: Fire damage each round while active. Blank = 1d6. Never offers a save.
